```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
#Resistance surface for KAZA, Etosha, West wet/dry (SSF v3)
# ------------------------------------------------------------

library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
library(here)

# 0. Configuring
# ------------------------------------------------------------
target_years <- 2008:2020          # <- replaces single target_year

gee_folder      <- here("data", "500m_data")
lc_dist_folder  <- here("data", "ESACCI_LCCS", "lc_dist_2")
lc_bin_folder   <- path.expand("~/Desktop/Arnhold/sparcle-hwc-old2/code/sparcle-hwc/data/ESACCI_LCCS/landcover")   # NEW: folder holding lc_[type]_[year].tif binary rasters
evi_folder      <- here("data", "500m_data", "EVI data")
model_folder    <- here("outputs")
out_folder      <- here("outputs", "resistance_surfaces")
lp_folder       <- here("outputs", "linear_predictors")
dir.create(out_folder, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(lp_folder,  showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# NEW: absolute paths for the updated fence / ephemeral river files
linear_folder      <- path.expand("~/Desktop/Arnhold/sparcle-hwc-old2/code/sparcle-hwc/data/Linear_features")
vet_fence_folder   <- file.path(linear_folder, "all_vet_fences")

# NEW: road distance raster (metres), built once from roads_selected_exported.shp (see road distance chunk below)
road_dist_path   <- file.path(linear_folder, "dist_roads_500m.tif")

# UPDATED: lc_types split into distance-based and binary categorical
lc_types    <- c("cropland", "grassland", "shrubland", "tree_cover", "urban", "water_rivers")
lc_dist_types <- c("cropland", "urban", "water_rivers")        # still distance rasters
lc_bin_types  <- c("grassland", "shrubland", "tree_cover")     # now binary categorical rasters
wet_months  <- c(1:4, 11:12)
dry_months  <- c(5:10)

target_res  <- 0.0045  # 500m in degrees
# (crop_extent and template are now set inside each population chunk below)

# 1. Load fitted SSF models
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# NEW: ssf_v3_results.rds is a list of 6 entries (etosha_wet, etosha_dry, west_wet,
# west_dry, kaza_wet, kaza_dry). Each entry holds $coefs (term, coef, se, exp_coef...),
# so the betas come from the coefs table instead of a saved model object.
ssf_results <- readRDS(here("outputs", "ssf_v3", "ssf_v3_results.rds"))
names(ssf_results)

# 2. Build static covariate raster (seasonal)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# UPDATED: ephemeral rivers now enter as PROXIMITY (ephemeral_rivers_prox), not distance, and road distance is
# BACK as road_log = log(road distance km + 0.25), matching the v3 SSF terms.
# fence_dist is still REMOVED: fences enter ONLY as the binary fence_cross layer in the linear feature stack below.
# Also dropped core_dist and ephemeral_rivers_dist: they are not terms in the v3 models.
build_static_stack <- function() {

  # UPDATED: ephemeral proximity exp(-d_km) (neg exp decay; already 0-1 in the file, so no unit conversion)
  eph_prox <- project(rast(file.path(linear_folder, paste0(pop_label, "_ephemeral_rivers_prox_1k_500m.tif"))), template, method = "bilinear")
  names(eph_prox) <- "ephemeral_rivers_prox"

  # NEW: road distance (file is in metres) -> km -> log(km + 0.25), same transform used when extracting for the SSF
  road_dist_r <- project(rast(road_dist_path), template, method = "bilinear") / 1000
  road_log    <- log(road_dist_r + 0.25)
  names(road_log) <- "road_log"

  terrain_r <- rast(file.path(gee_folder, "terrain_rast_500m.tif"))
  terrain_r <- project(terrain_r, template, method = "bilinear")

  c(eph_prox, road_log, terrain_r)
}

#Linear feature stack 
build_linear_stack <- function() {

  # UPDATED: names match the model's *_cross coefficients; all are 0/1 line rasters
  # (fence_cross and road_cross are the binary categorical versions of fences and roads)
  linear_files <- c(
    river_cross     = file.path(linear_folder, "perennial_rivers_cross_500m.tif"),
    fence_cross     = file.path(vet_fence_folder, "vetfences_all_500m.tif"),
    road_cross      = file.path(linear_folder, "roads_cross_500m.tif"),
    ephemeral_cross = file.path(linear_folder, "ephemeral_rivers_cross_500m.tif")
  )

  r_list  <- map(linear_files, ~ project(rast(.x), template, method = "near"))
  r_stack <- rast(r_list)
  names(r_stack) <- names(linear_files)
  r_stack
}

# WorldPop: load + project all layers once; pull one layer per year later
load_world_pop_all <- function() {
  wp <- rast(file.path(gee_folder, "worldPop_comb_img_500m.tif"))
  project(wp, template, method = "bilinear")
}

# 3. Build land-cover stack for a given year (year-specific, not averaged across years)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# UPDATED: cropland/urban/water_rivers remain distance rasters (bilinear);
# grassland/shrubland/tree_cover are now binary categorical rasters (nearest neighbour)
build_lc_dist_year <- function(year) {

  # distance rasters
  paths <- setNames(
    file.path(lc_dist_folder, paste0("dist_", lc_dist_types, "_", year, ".tif")),
    lc_dist_types
  )
  paths <- paths[file.exists(paths)]

  missing_lc <- setdiff(lc_dist_types, names(paths))
  if (length(missing_lc) > 0) {
    warning("Land-cover distance rasters missing for ", year, ": ",
            paste(missing_lc, collapse = ", "))
  }

  r_list  <- map(paths, ~ project(rast(.x), template, method = "bilinear"))
  r_stack <- rast(r_list)
  names(r_stack) <- paste0(names(paths), "_dist")

  # NEW: binary land-cover rasters
  bin_paths <- setNames(
    file.path(lc_bin_folder, paste0("lc_", lc_bin_types, "_", year, ".tif")),
    lc_bin_types
  )
  bin_paths <- bin_paths[file.exists(bin_paths)]

  missing_bin <- setdiff(lc_bin_types, names(bin_paths))
  if (length(missing_bin) > 0) {
    warning("Binary land-cover rasters missing for ", year, ": ",
            paste(missing_bin, collapse = ", "))
  }

  bin_list  <- map(bin_paths, ~ project(rast(.x), template, method = "near"))
  bin_stack <- rast(bin_list)
  names(bin_stack) <- names(bin_paths)

  c(r_stack, bin_stack)
}

# 4. Build EVI mean surface for given season
# ------------------------------------------------------------
 
build_evi_year <- function(season, year) {

  fp <- if (season == "dry") {
    file.path(evi_folder, paste0("evi_dry_", year, ".tif"))
  } else {
    # wet season files span year boundaries: evi_wet_(yr-1)_(yr).tif
    file.path(evi_folder, paste0("evi_wet_", year - 1, "_", year, ".tif"))
  }

  if (!file.exists(fp)) {
    stop("EVI raster not found for ", season, " ", year, ": ", fp)
  }

  r <- project(rast(fp), template, method = "bilinear")
  names(r) <- "evi"
  r
}

# 5. Build population mean surface across years
# ------------------------------------------------------------
build_world_pop_year <- function(year) {
  layer_idx <- year - 1999  # matches indexing used in the SSF extraction script
  if (layer_idx < 1 || layer_idx > nlyr(world_pop_all)) {
    stop("No world_pop layer available for year ", year)
  }
  pop <- world_pop_all[[layer_idx]]
  names(pop) <- "world_pop"
  pop
}


# 6. Full covariate stack for one season
# ------------------------------------------------------------

build_covariate_stack <- function(season, year) {
  c(static_stack,
    linear_stack,
    build_lc_dist_year(year),
    build_evi_year(season, year),
    build_world_pop_year(year))
}

# 7. Predict linear predictor / SSF from model coefficients (REVISED)
# -----------------------------------------------------------

predict_ssf_surface <- function(model, covariate_stack) {
 
  # UPDATED: the v3 results store a coefficient table ($coefs: term, coef, ...) rather than a model object,
  # so build the named beta vector from that table
  betas <- setNames(model$coefs$coef, model$coefs$term)
  betas <- betas[!is.na(betas)]  # Remove any variables that failed to calculate (ignore NA values) 
  
  
  #TAKING A SUBSET OF COVARIATES
  # if (!is.null(keep)) betas <- betas[names(betas) %in% keep]
 # if (length(betas) == 0) stop("None of the requested covariates are in the model.")
 # message("Using: ", paste(names(betas), collapse = ", "))
  
  
#compare names of variables in the model against the names of the map layers provided. Creates a list of any required variables that are missing from the map. If there is something missing, triggers an error and prints what is missing
  missing_in_stack <- setdiff(names(betas), names(covariate_stack))
  if (length(missing_in_stack) > 0) {
    stop("Model covariates missing from raster stack: ",
         paste(missing_in_stack, collapse = ", "))
  }
 
  #using name based indexing to prevent the wrong coefficient multiplying by the wrong variable. Retrieves corresponding layer and multiplies that entire layer by its matching scalar weight. 
  weighted <- lapply(names(betas), function(nm) covariate_stack[[nm]] * betas[[nm]])
  
  #sums all the weighted layers into a linear predictor 
  lp <- sum(rast(weighted))   #linear predictor surface
  names(lp) <- "linear_predictor"
  lp
  
}

# 8. Linear predictor to resistance surface
# ------------------------------------------------------------

lp_to_resistance <- function(lp, min_resistance = 1, max_resistance = 100,
                             clip = c(0.01, 0.99), clip_values = NULL) {
#mess around with shape parameter 

#Takes 1st percentile and 99th percentile values of preference scores and cuts any below or above this because extreme outliers
  q <- if (is.null(clip_values)) {
    as.numeric(quantile(values(lp, na.rm = TRUE), probs = clip))
  } else clip_values
  lp_c <- clamp(lp, lower = q[1], upper = q[2])
  
  # Uses min max normalization to transform preferences into h, a scale running from 0 to 1 (0 = least selected habitat, 1 = most selected habitat)
  h <- (lp_c - q[1]) / (q[2] - q[1])
  
  # Non-linear Exponential Resistance Transformation
  # As h approaches 1 (high selection), resistance approaches min_resistance 
  # As h approaches 0 (lower selection), resistance rises toward max_resistance
  # shape_parameter controls curvature (larger = resistance drops off faster as habitat improves)
  # the (1 - exp(-c*h)) / (1 - exp(-c)) term is already scaled to 0-1, so resistance hits exactly min/max without a separate rescaling step.
  #resistance <- max_resistance -
    #(max_resistance - min_resistance) *
    #((1 - exp(-shape_parameter * h)) / (1 - exp(-shape_parameter)))
  
  # Linear transformation:
  # h = 1 (high selection) -> min_resistance
  # h = 0 (low selection)  -> max_resistance
  resistance <- max_resistance - (max_resistance - min_resistance) * h
  
  names(resistance) <- "resistance"
  
  resistance
 
}

#9. Run season across all years 
# ------------------------------------------------------------
run_resistance_all_years <- function(model, season, pop_label, valid_area,
                                     years = target_years,
                                     common_clip = TRUE) {

#Linear predictor for each year
  lp_list <- list()
  for (yr in years) {
    message("[", pop_label, "-", season, "] building LP for ", yr)

    lp <- tryCatch({
      cov_stack <- build_covariate_stack(season, yr)
      mask(predict_ssf_surface(model, cov_stack), valid_area)
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning("Skipping ", season, " ", yr, ": ", conditionMessage(e))
      NULL
    })
    if (is.null(lp)) next

    names(lp) <- paste0("lp_", yr)
    writeRaster(lp,
                file.path(lp_folder, paste0("lp_", pop_label, "_", season, "_", yr, ".tif")),
                overwrite = TRUE)
    lp_list[[as.character(yr)]] <- lp
  }
  if (length(lp_list) == 0) stop("No years completed for ", season)

#Clip bounds
  clip_values <- NULL
  if (common_clip) {
    pooled <- unlist(lapply(lp_list, function(r) values(r, na.rm = TRUE)))
    clip_values <- as.numeric(quantile(pooled, probs = c(0.01, 0.99)))
    message("Common LP clip bounds: ", paste(round(clip_values, 3), collapse = " to "))
  }

#resistance surface per year
  res_list <- list()
  for (yr in names(lp_list)) {
    message("[", pop_label, "-", season, "] resistance for ", yr)
    res <- lp_to_resistance(lp_list[[yr]], clip_values = clip_values)
    writeRaster(res,
                file.path(out_folder, paste0("resistance_", pop_label, "_", season, "_", yr, ".tif")),
                overwrite = TRUE)
    res_list[[yr]] <- res
  }

#resistance from the mean LP across years (same clip bounds)
  lp_mean  <- mean(rast(lp_list))
  res_mean <- lp_to_resistance(lp_mean, clip_values = clip_values)
  yrs      <- as.integer(names(lp_list))
  writeRaster(res_mean,
              file.path(out_folder, paste0("resistance_", pop_label, "_", season,
                                           "_meanLP_", min(yrs), "-", max(yrs), ".tif")),
              overwrite = TRUE)

  by_year <- rast(res_list)
  names(by_year) <- names(res_list)   # layer names become the years, e.g. "2008"
  list(by_year = by_year, mean_lp = res_mean)
}
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Road distance raster (RUN ONCE)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# NEW: road distance raster (metres), same recipe as the SSF script, but cropped to the study area so it runs fast
if (!file.exists(road_dist_path)) {
  library(sf)

  roads <- st_read(file.path(linear_folder, "roads_selected_exported.shp"), quiet = TRUE) |> st_zm()
  tmpl  <- rast(file.path(vet_fence_folder, "dist_vetfences_500m.tif"))   # 500 m grid used for the SSF road distance
  ncell(tmpl)   # just to see how big the full grid is

  # crop to the study area (KAZA's extent contains Etosha and West) plus a margin so distances near the edge stay correct
  study_ext <- ext(project(as.polygons(ext(12, 26, -22, -16), crs = "EPSG:4326"), crs(tmpl)))
  tmpl      <- crop(tmpl, study_ext)
  ncell(tmpl)   # should be much smaller than above

  roads_v <- crop(vect(st_transform(roads, crs(tmpl))), ext(tmpl))
  road_r  <- rasterize(roads_v, tmpl, field = 1, touches = TRUE)

  system.time(
    writeRaster(distance(road_r), road_dist_path, overwrite = TRUE)   # metres
  )
}

global(rast(road_dist_path), c("min", "max"), na.rm = TRUE)   # checkpoint: min 0, max in the tens of thousands (metres)
```



```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# KAZA
# ------------------------------------------------------------
pop_label <- "kaza"

crop_extent <- ext(12.5, 25.5, -21.5, -16.5)
template    <- rast(crop_extent, resolution = target_res, crs = "EPSG:4326")

valid_area_kaza <- vect(here("outputs", "kaza_valid_area.gpkg"))

static_stack  <- build_static_stack()
linear_stack  <- build_linear_stack()
world_pop_all <- load_world_pop_all()

# Run
res_kaza_wet <- run_resistance_all_years(ssf_results[["kaza_wet"]], "wet", pop_label, valid_area_kaza, common_clip = TRUE)
res_kaza_dry <- run_resistance_all_years(ssf_results[["kaza_dry"]], "dry", pop_label, valid_area_kaza, common_clip = TRUE)

# Visualize
plot(res_kaza_wet$by_year[[c("2011")]])
plot(res_kaza_wet$by_year[[c("2020")]])
plot(res_kaza_dry$by_year[[c("2011")]])
plot(res_kaza_dry$by_year[[c("2020")]])
plot(res_kaza_wet$mean_lp, main = "KAZA Wet Resistance (mean LP)")
plot(res_kaza_dry$mean_lp, main = "KAZA Dry Resistance (mean LP)")
plet(res_kaza_wet$mean_lp, col = rev(terrain.colors(100)), tiles = "OpenStreetMap")
plet(res_kaza_dry$mean_lp, col = rev(terrain.colors(100)), tiles = "OpenStreetMap")
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# ETOSHA
# ------------------------------------------------------------
pop_label <- "etosha"

# Area where the Etosha SSF is valid (used to mask out extrapolated pixels)
ele_trk_extract_etosha <- readRDS(here("outputs", "ele_trk_extract_etosha.rds"))

etosha_pts <- ele_trk_extract_etosha |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  filter(case_ == 1) |>     # used steps only (not random steps)
  select(x2_, y2_) |>
  drop_na()

etosha_vect <- vect(etosha_pts, geom = c("x2_", "y2_"), crs = "EPSG:4326")

# Convex hull encompassing all used GPS steps
valid_area_etosha <- convHull(etosha_vect)
writeVector(valid_area_etosha, here("outputs", "etosha_valid_area.gpkg"), overwrite = TRUE)

# Extent is taken from the valid area polygon so the template matches the model's study area
crop_extent <- ext(valid_area_etosha)
template    <- rast(crop_extent, resolution = target_res, crs = "EPSG:4326")

static_stack  <- build_static_stack()
linear_stack  <- build_linear_stack()
world_pop_all <- load_world_pop_all()

# Run
# (river_cross was merged into ephemeral for Etosha, so it is not in these coefficients and is ignored automatically)
res_etosha_wet <- run_resistance_all_years(ssf_results[["etosha_wet"]], "wet", pop_label, valid_area_etosha, common_clip = TRUE)
res_etosha_dry <- run_resistance_all_years(ssf_results[["etosha_dry"]], "dry", pop_label, valid_area_etosha, common_clip = TRUE)

# Visualize
plot(res_etosha_wet$by_year[[c("2008", "2014")]])
plot(res_etosha_dry$by_year[[c("2008", "2014")]])
plot(res_etosha_wet$mean_lp, main = "Etosha Wet Resistance (mean LP)")
plot(res_etosha_dry$mean_lp, main = "Etosha Dry Resistance (mean LP)")
plet(res_etosha_wet$mean_lp, col = rev(terrain.colors(100)), tiles = "OpenStreetMap")
plet(res_etosha_dry$mean_lp, col = rev(terrain.colors(100)), tiles = "OpenStreetMap")
```
